exceptions.reason: Membership exception, not proven unreachability. Each recorded chain is bounded: HMR compiles the operator-owned `ignored` configuration into picomatch patterns (packages/boot/hmr, vendor/hmr); the webworker packer compiles its fixed EXCLUDE/PAGE_ASSETS constants and each packed manifest's `files` allowlist; the experimental webworker runtime shell expands caller-supplied glob words (bash -c, find -name) with picomatch inside a dedicated, SIGKILL-able Web Worker whose preview performs no model inference; and the remaining chains are test-run tooling (vitest, tinyglobby, fdir). ReDoS needs a malicious pattern string: the shell is the only path where a caller-supplied pattern reaches picomatch and it is contained by that worker boundary. No fixed release is published (patched_versions null with patched_versions_unpublished), so the dependency cannot be updated yet; re-evaluate when picomatch 4.0.8+ publishes. Caller options and embedded identity require recorded source review outside this CI membership check.
